## Parent-bound audit finding

The inherited module-completion instructions conflict about when screenshots are embedded in the recap.

Audited merged main: `04ded7494d3e5ac0c1c543b964128acc5ef83d00`; release/parent version 0.5.3; production parent commit `7e2d484f6cfe9af864762e0a0c95119d483cbb08`; inventory digest `3920dd4ab0e3c9a1359689e8437475ec1c152f00c0a831873260b0bd3872377f`.

## Evidence

In `plugins/senzing-bootcamp/skills/bootcamp-onboarding/module-completion.md`:

- Lines 124–131 explicitly separate two moments: record capture paths at the step checkpoint now, then embed them in Actions Taken at module close. They explain that the recap section does not yet exist at capture time and questions intervene before close.
- Lines 312–317 require embedding all captured tabs in that recap Actions Taken in the same turn as successful capture, while also saying to record the capture at the step checkpoint.

Both directives are mandatory but cannot both be followed on the documented intervening-question path without creating the finalized recap section early. The content at both sites is present in the pinned production parent, not introduced by the Codex host-language transformation.

## Routing and next action

**Parent-bound**: this is inherited curriculum/recap timing, not a Codex lifecycle or packaging adapter. The human approved creating this tracking issue and using `escalate-to-parent`. The canonical correction belongs in the Claude development parent; this child must import a verified tagged fix through parity, never edit the inherited curriculum independently.

All local/parent issue pages, open and closed, were searched. Related parent #523 addresses capture ordering relative to starting the visualization server, #333 addresses missing module-specific capture pointers, and #229/#234 concern stale prose/comments. These do not settle the contradictory embed-time instructions above. No matching issue was found. No Senzing product claim needs MCP verification: the finding is an internal instruction-order contradiction only.

## Acceptance criteria

- Parent has one coherent capture/checkpoint/embed timeline: capture evidence durable before yielding; recap embeds every capture at the defined owning step without prematurely finalizing the module.
- Both existing instructions and relevant callers agree; retain all-tab inclusion, image-derived captions, relative paths, and nonblocking capture fallback.
